subject: Re: AssembleNet status: repro done, memory is the deciding factor
body:
Yusuf, Santiago,

Decision: AssembleNet++Lite is the variant we take forward. 2.4 points over the current backbone at 40% of the activation memory is a shipping result; the extra 0.8 from full ++ costs a serving redesign we aren't doing this year.

Scope cuts to keep the June 29 readout clean: we drop the custom model_structure exploration — running our own connectivity search is a Q3 proposal with its own compute case, not something to squeeze in now. And we do not port the TF1 code to TF2 in this window; the container holds.

Santiago, please release the Vulcan reservation early since the runs finished June 18 — no reason to sit on 96 H100s through maintenance.

Lucia
